pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark contiguous regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Geometry transitions from elongated, sub-rectangular forms on the neck to more compact, multi-sided polygons on the chest and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively stable, narrowing slightly at the vertices of the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous 1D serrated edge along the dorsal line of the neck, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude hair projections against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A vertical, out-of-focus foreground occlusion (likely vegetation) creates a soft-edged visual artifact running vertically through the center of the frame, partially masking the chest and neck patches.
